# Erset Platform

> Erset (a brand of Set Platform Makine İnşaat San. Tic. Ltd. Şti.) is a Turkish
> manufacturer of construction lifting equipment, producing since 1986. Erset builds
> mast-climbing platform scaffolding (ERP series) and passenger/material construction
> hoists (ERY series), exporting to more than 15 countries. Key engineering strengths:
> patented mechanical parachute safety brakes, high-torque planetary drive systems,
> high-strength masts, modular cabins and fault-display control systems.

## Products — Platform Scaffolding (ERP series, 2022 catalogue)
- [ERP 1050 — Single-mast work platform](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/erp-1050): 1,500 kg, 13.5 m platform, 120 m standard or 250 m ultra-high.
- [ERP 3000 — Twin-mast work platform](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/erp-3000): 3,000 kg, 30 m platform, 120 m standard or 250 m ultra-high.
- [ERP 4000 — Twin-mast work platform](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/erp-4000): 3,000 kg, 30 m platform, up to 250 m.

## Products — Hoists (ERY series, 2022 catalogue)
- [ERY 1000 — Construction hoist](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/ery-1000): 1,000 kg, up to 120 m.
- [ERY 2000-450 — Construction hoist](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/ery-2000-450): 2,000 kg, up to 200 m.
- [ERY 2000-650 — Double-cabin hoist](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/ery-2000-650): 2,000 kg per cabin, up to 250 m.
- [ERY 2500-650 — Construction hoist](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/ery-2500-650): 2,500 kg, up to 250 m.
- [ERY 3000/4000/5000 — Material transport hoist](https://erset.com.tr/en/urunler/ery-3000-4000-5000): 3,000, 4,000 and 5,000 kg configurations.
